# C2R Marketing — llms.txt

## About
C2R Marketing, LLC is the home base for AI visibility audits for churches,
dentists, and realtors; free guides; books; and tools. Run by Tov Rose.

## What we do
- AI Visibility Audit ($147 one time): what ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and
  Claude say about a business, who they cite instead, and the top five fixes.
  Written report within five business days.
  - Churches: https://c2r-marketing.github.io/ai-visibility-audit-churches/
  - Dentists: https://c2rmarketing.com/audit/
  - Realtors: https://c2r-marketing.github.io/ai-visibility-audit-realtors/
- Free guides: the llms.txt guide — https://c2rmarketing.com/guide/llms-txt/
- Books and digital products: https://c2rmarketing.com/#books
- The New Messianic Version Bible: https://nmvbible.org/
- Tov Rose's books and store: https://tovrose.com/
